settings.hero_desc: A large designer blue doodle bearbrick 1000%, hand-painted head to toe in a deep blue colourway with intricate white line-art and icon branding. A bold collectible art toy that makes a statement on a shelf, in a lobby or on a retail display.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your preferred base color or icons
settings.s1_body: This oversized designer blue bearbrick 1000% figure is a blank canvas turned statement piece - hand-painted in a rich blue palette with detailed white doodle artwork wrapping the whole body, finished with icon branding. Perfect as a collectible centrepiece, a branded retail display, or a standout corporate gift. Details of famous icons add a unique element to this beabrick collectable.
settings.case_body: Produced as a custom-painted collectible, this figure pairs a recognisable designer-toy silhouette with bespoke artwork and branding - ideal for collectors, brand activations and statement retail displays. We tailor the colourway and artwork to the customer or campaign.
settings.case_quote: Wow, I love it. The artwork is unreal up close. It's the centrepiece of my collection now.
settings.prov_p: The Bearbrick 1000% designer-toy form has become a favourite canvas for artists and brands precisely because its simple silhouette lets the artwork shine. Hand-painted and branded, each piece becomes one of a kind.
